echoFarm.title: Echo Farming Calculator
echoFarm.disclaimer: Main-stat/substat probabilities are sourced from Kuro's own disclosed substat rates and a large community sample for main stats. Waveplate/Shell Credit estimates assume any dropped Echo could be your target, since no source publishes drop rate by Sonata Set or cost tier — treat these as order-of-magnitude, not exact.
